findings.page: Page 2 — Stock dashboard manual scan trigger
findings.evidence: POST /api/admin/stock/scan-rupture/run returned HTTP 422 ('No branch available for stock rupture scan.') with no toast/alert in UI. Root cause: StockRuptureDashboardController::scopedBranches() filtered Branch::where('status', 1) while Branch model uses canonical Status::ACTIVE=5 enum. scopedBranches returned 0 → branchId=0 → abort_if 422.
findings.fix_applied: app/Http/Controllers/Admin/StockRuptureDashboardController.php — import Status enum + change where('status', 1) to whereIn('status', [Status::ACTIVE, 1]) (mirroring PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox L39 bridge pattern). Verified post-heal: curl POST → {"ok":true,"exit_code":0,"branch_id":1}.

findings.evidence: GET /api/admin/delivery-boy returned HTTP 422 'There is no role with id `3`.' Cause: DeliveryBoyService::list() called User::role(EnumRole::DELIVERY_BOY) passing int 3. Spatie HasRoles::scopeRole (L84) does is_numeric($role) ? findById : findByName — so int 3 is treated as roles.id PK, but the Spatie roles table AUTO_INCREMENT had skipped past 3 (current IDs 73-77). Same latent bug pattern exists in WaiterService.php:41, ChefService.php:40, CustomerService.php:40, AdministratorService.php:43 (5 sites total, only DeliveryBoyService fixed within scope).
findings.fix_applied: app/Services/DeliveryBoyService.php L40 — replaced ->role(EnumRole::DELIVERY_BOY) with ->role('Delivery Boy', 'sanctum') (name lookup stable across AUTO_INCREMENT churn). Also seeded 5 missing Spatie roles via tinker firstOrCreate (Customer/Delivery Boy/Waiter/Branch Manager/Stuff). Verified post-heal: list endpoint returns 200, page renders 'Livreur E2E' row.
findings.latent_pattern_left_open: WaiterService::list, ChefService::list, CustomerService::list, AdministratorService::list — same is_numeric trap will trigger 422 the moment any of those pages is exercised. Out of scope for this wave, documented for V1.0.2 follow-up sweep.

findings.page: Page 8 (Items edit breadcrumb) + Page 10 (Order detail breadcrumb)
findings.evidence: Breadcrumb final segment rendered literal 'menu.view' string. BreadcrumbComponent.vue L16 does $t('menu.'+val.meta.breadcrumb); the meta.breadcrumb is 'view' for show routes (itemRoutes.js:88, onlineOrderRoutes.js:40, etc., 10+ routes). Vue-i18n returns the key untranslated when missing. fr.json had no menu.view entry (en.json + ar.json already had it: View / عرض).
findings.fix_applied: resources/js/languages/fr.json — added "menu.view": "Voir". Ran npm run dev (Mix compile 10.4s). Re-ran Page 8 + Page 10: 0 occurrences of 'menu.view' in DOM, breadcrumb now reads 'Voir'.
